title: Verify: Round poller and expired-Round closer unit tests with mocked Git and clock
summary: Unit tests for detection, closing, snapshot immutability
description: Tests use a fake Git recording calls, a fixed clock and t.TempDir.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot mode 0444 and CLOSED round.yaml asserted
technical_constraints: Fixture shape mirrors backend/internal/round/snapshot.go and backend/internal/round/round.go yaml tags

steps.action: Write round.yaml files (fixture written by a helper that marshals rounds.Round, whose tags mirror backend round.Round) for SCHEDULED, OPEN, CLOSED; with fakeGit counting Pull, assert scheduled has 1 and closed has 1 entry and Pull was called once

With Now fixed after EndsAt and fakeGit returning one Contribution and Head 'abc123': assert snapshot.yaml exists with Mode().Perm()==0o444, its prompt_sha256 equals sha256 of the prompt, round.yaml has status CLOSED, freeze_commit abc123 and closed_at set, and fakeGit.Commit received the snapshot path; with Now before EndsAt assert no files change; with a pre-existing snapshot.yaml assert error and contents unchanged
